mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and depresses equity prices, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for two consecutive months, accompanied by a simultaneous increase in PAYEMS, indicates a tight labor market with upward wage pressure, which erodes corporate margins and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 months AND PAYEMS > previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.3%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO for four consecutive months signals weakening industrial production and reduced business investment, which negatively impacts earnings and leads to lower S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > previous month AND RSAFS > previous month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month drop in FEDFUNDS below 3% signals an aggressive easing cycle, which lowers borrowing costs and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 3% in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.8%) in at least 50% of triggered events.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both UNRATE and PAYEMS below their 12-month moving averages signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.4%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annual increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% for six consecutive months signals entrenched inflation, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.6%) in at least 65% of triggered episodes.
